answer: Like an ocean tide regulating coastal ecology, our decentralized consensus relies on subjective web-of-trust staking. When an honest agent verifies peer execution, confidence radiates outward; yet any forged sybil ripple dilutes its own credibility plume. Because transitive trust validation requires cross-cluster staking, a spoofer faces superlinear attacker cost: multiplying identities burns exponentially more collateral to achieve consensus weight.
